items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, we got together -- you know -- with Steve... So we scuffled and -- you know -- I was in the band and Teddy was in the band.

ctx.x: But, Jones left -- Willie Jones -- I don't know what happened to him. Anyway, we got together -- you know -- with Steve and Steve had very many promises as (unintelligible). But nothing but promises -- that's all. You dig?
So we scuffled and -- you know -- I was in the band and Teddy was in the band. They're brothers. Both had brothers you know and they were in the band.
